result.reason: The amendment is targeted and preserves unrelated commercial terms, but it does not reach the playbook position. Affiliates and contractors are added only to the Section 2.1 hosting licence, not the Section 2.2 internal-use licence. In addition, Section 2.2 is fully paid-up and perpetual but is not made irrevocable. Successor transfer may be covered by Section 14.1, but that cannot be confirmed from the language provided. The margin comment does not cure these operative omissions.
